name: Provider failover
purpose: A call is still answered when the primary provider fails, and a failure that is not the provider's (a bad request, a bad key) is raised, not hidden.
record: Cases passed over 30 recorded provider failures (billing, quota, timeout, outage, none) against fake providers: no model, no network, no key.
disadvantages: Fake providers use the vendors' published error wordings; a vendor that changes its wording is not seen until the cases are updated.
cascading_conditionals: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new alternative is described: rate its description on the five questions of the scale before it is built] > offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=competitive | when=fake providers raise each recorded failure; free, so the whole set always runs]
